prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. The ONLY named human protagonist is Zoe. Kit MUST NOT appear. Ignore every other child shown in reference sheets; unnamed adults may appear only when this scene explicitly requires them. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Moon in Daylight; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: An ordinary park under a bright pale-blue late-afternoon sky. A waxing half-Moon is roughly a quarter-turn around the sky from the unseen Sun, not opposite it. Choose a northern-hemisphere viewing angle with the Moon’s right half lit. Sun stays well outside the composition; no looking toward the Sun.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One small white waxing half-Moon, right half lit, same shape through the sequence; One broad white cloud drifting left to right; Low park bench; No stars or visible Sun
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Daylight; Moon visible; cloud separate to left.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Zoe looks up from the park bench beneath a bright blue daytime sky; half-Moon small but visible near upper center, a cloud well left.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.

visualReview.note: Directly viewed Zoe-only models, wooden bench, one cloud and small right-lit half Moon in blue daytime sky. No night stars or Sun; later cloud positions controlled by page state.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image and sequence inspection; no classroom or physical-device observation.
